description: This source file implements pathfinding algorithms, specifically A* search, for the Wesnoth game. It includes functions for initializing and exploring nodes, performing A* search, and utility functions for map analysis such as finding vacant tiles and calculating movement routes.

classes.name: shortest_path_calculator
classes.description: A class for calculating the shortest path for a unit considering game-specific constraints.

methods.name: a_star_init
methods.description: Initializes the A* search by setting up start node, open list, and teleport locations.

methods.name: a_star_explore_neighbours
methods.description: Explores neighboring nodes during A* search, updating open list and node costs.

methods.name: a_star_search
methods.description: Performs the A* pathfinding algorithm between source and destination locations.

methods.name: find_vacant
methods.description: Recursively searches for a vacant tile within a certain depth.

methods.name: find_vacant_tile
methods.description: Finds a vacant tile near a location, increasing search depth iteratively.

methods.name: get_tiles_radius_internal
methods.description: Internal helper to get all tiles within a radius.

methods.name: get_tiles_radius
methods.description: Calculates all tiles within a radius from a point.

methods.name: get_tiles_radius
methods.description: Calculates all tiles within a radius from multiple locations.

methods.name: enemy_zoc
methods.description: Checks if a location is under enemy zone of control.

methods.name: find_routes
methods.description: Recursively finds movement routes for a unit considering obstacles and ZOC.

methods.name: route_turns_to_complete
methods.description: Calculates the number of turns required to complete a movement route.

methods.name: shortest_path_calculator::cost
methods.description: Calculates the movement cost for a location considering game rules and visibility.
